source.title: Report on the open problems session

evidence.quote: This report summarizes the problems presented during the last session of the “Algebra meets Topology: Advances and Applications” conference in honor of Dikran Dikranjan on his 60th birthday, Barcelona, July 20–23, 2010.

trace.notes: Resolved the zbMATH record to DOI 10.1016/j.topol.2012.04.009 and the matching ScienceDirect article page. In this environment, the readable page exposed title, bibliographic metadata, and abstract, but not the article body or problem statements.

Failed the source adequacy gate because the accessible same-work source was abstract-level only; extracting open problems from bibliographic metadata or abstract text would violate the no-new-facts rule.
Saved exact JSON to outputs/parse-paper/10.1016_j.topol.2012.04.009.json and updated outputs/latest.json.
